description: This file defines the interface for managing process containers, including creation, destruction, starting, stopping, and retrieving status information about containers. It includes structure definitions, error codes, and function prototypes for container operations.

methods.name: process_container_logging
methods.description: Initializes container logging with specified log path and options.

methods.name: process_container_deinitialize
methods.description: Releases resources held by the container framework.

methods.name: process_container_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a container with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: process_container_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a container and releases its resources.

methods.name: process_container_start
methods.description: Starts a command within the specified container.

methods.name: process_container_running
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: process_container_memory_status
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information for the container.

methods.name: process_container_cpu_usage
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage for the container or a specific thread.

methods.name: process_container_pid
methods.description: Returns the PID of a process within the container.

methods.name: process_container_network_status_create
methods.description: Retrieves network configuration information for the container.

methods.name: process_container_network_status_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with network status information.
